200.description: User already exists (returns success to prevent user enumeration)

post.description: Send a password reset code to the user's email
Reset user password using a valid password reset code

patch.description: Update user profile information. At least one field (fullName, email, or newPassword) must be provided. Password fields are optional - if provided, both newPassword and newPasswordConfirmation must be included and meet security requirements. currentPassword is required if newPassword is provided.

value.message: At least one field is expected: fullName, email, newPassword
Password must be at least 8 characters long and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character
Both newPassword and newPasswordConfirmation are required
Current password is required to change password
New password cannot be the same as the current password

patch.description: Marks a notification as read by setting its read_at timestamp. This endpoint does not require a request body - it automatically marks the notification as read when called. The endpoint is designed to be scalable for future updates to other notification fields.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the notification to update

400.description: Missing fields or invalid seedReadings value

value.error: Missing fields, expected: name, serialNumber, countryId, address, postalCode

value.message: Expected seedReadings to be a boolean value, got string

get.description: Retrieve device details, current sensor readings (cards), and historical data (charts).

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Data range for charts (hour, week, fortnight, month)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the device to update

requestBody.description: Fields to update. At least one must be provided.

value.message: At least one field is expected: name, countryId, address, postalCode
Name must be at least 3 characters long

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the device to delete

emergency_number.description: Emergency phone number for the country

seedReadings.description: If true, creates 12 fake readings for the newly created device. If false or not provided, only creates the device without readings. If provided, must be a valid boolean value.

UpdateDeviceRequestBody.description: At least one property must be provided

has_active_alert.description: Indicates if the device has an active alert (non-canceled MCU detection)

newPassword.description: New password (optional). Must be at least 8 characters long and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character. If provided, newPasswordConfirmation is also required.

newPasswordConfirmation.description: Password confirmation (required if newPassword is provided). Must match the newPassword field.

currentPassword.description: Current password (required if newPassword is provided).

UpdateUserRequestBody.description: At least one property must be provided (fullName, email, or newPassword)

code.description: The password reset code, only returned in development environment
